# Test source

```ts
  1  | /**
  2  |  * NFR-03 Usability - Owner: Member 1 - Aimen
  3  |  * A1 wording: consistent and understandable interface that lets users complete common communication tasks
  4  |  * without unnecessary difficulty.
  5  |  * Measurable form (two indicators):
  6  |  *   (1) Accessibility: 0 "critical" axe-core WCAG 2.0/2.1 A+AA violations on the sign-up page, login page
  7  |  *       and a channel view (the screens of the critical workflow).
  8  |  *   (2) Task efficiency: the common task "open a channel and send a message" completes in the UI in
  9  |  *       <= 5 s (median of 3 attempts, measured from navigation to message visible).
  10 |  */
  11 | import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
  12 | import AxeBuilder from '@axe-core/playwright';
  13 | import { keyword } from '../../utils/api';
  14 | import { rt } from '../../utils/runtime';
  15 | import { uiLogin, openChannel, uiPost } from '../../utils/ui';
  16 | import { actual, meta, saveNfr } from '../../utils/evidence';
  17 | import thresholds from '../../test-data/nfr-thresholds.json';
  18 | 
  19 | const TAGS = ['wcag2a', 'wcag2aa', 'wcag21a', 'wcag21aa'];
  20 | 
  21 | function summarize(violations: { id: string; impact?: string | null; nodes: unknown[]; help: string }[]) {
```
